# OMP Plan Protection

> Standalone Oh My Pi (OMP) plugin that prevents stale-plan substitution during plan mode.

## Canonical facts

- Package: `omp-plan-protection`.
- Runtime entrypoint: `dist/extension.js` through `package.json#omp.extensions`.
- Hard guard: programmer-only `tool_call` interception for `write` calls targeting `xd://propose`.
- Accepted proposal: one strict plan slug whose exact `local://<slug>-plan.md` file already exists.
- Invalid Markdown, empty, whitespace, traversal, or missing-artifact proposals are blocked before OMP dispatch.
- Valid slug/artifact proposals are passed through unchanged.
- Optional advisor: OMP native `complete()` call, max 160 output tokens, reasoning disabled, two calls per session, UI-only output.
- No Meridian dependency. No `claude -p`. No transcript or full-plan upload.
- Global install: `node scripts/install-all-profiles.mjs`.
- Manual programmer proof: `npm run e2e:programmer`.
- Manual advisor proof: `npm run e2e:advisor` and `npm run e2e:advisor:live`.
- Manual report: `audit-reports/omp-global-plan-protection-2026-08-31.md`.

## Installation

```bash
omp plugin link E:/repos/omp-plan-protection --scope user
node scripts/install-all-profiles.mjs
```

## Safety boundary

The advisor is explanatory only. It cannot approve, rewrite, or unblock a hard guard decision.
The deterministic identity check is the source of truth.

## Repository

GitHub: https://github.com/stgmt/omp-plan-protection
